notes: The kernel argument correctly includes n=0, avoiding the documented pitfall. However, Section 6 falsely concludes that uniqueness is strictly stronger than the kernel dichotomy. In R=Z/4Z, the only idempotents are 0 and 1, so g is the unique nonzero homomorphism from Z, yet ker(g)=4Z violates the dichotomy. The core conditional proofs are otherwise valid.
